title: Trigger smoke-deploy.yml on push to main/staging and wait on /build.json; check_run and deployment_status never fire for Pages
body:
Cloudflare Pages creates no GitHub Deployment, so `deployment_status` never fires (the first version of the smoke ran 0 times for weeks while CI looked green). Pages publishes a check run, but `check_run` and `workflow_dispatch` only run a workflow whose file exists on the DEFAULT branch (`main`) — a smoke edited on `develop` does nothing until it reaches main. The current trigger is `push` to `main`/`staging` plus a poll of `$SITE/build.json` until it returns `github.sha` (never a fixed sleep: it would verify the previous deploy and pass green).
The workflow is what sets `SITE` (main -> https://cribbnicolas.pages.dev, staging -> https://staging.cribbnicolas.pages.dev), `PDF_SOURCE` and `EN_PDF_SOURCE`; `scripts/served.check.ts` (`pnpm run test:served`) refuses to run without `SITE`. A new deploying branch needs a case in 'Resolve this branch's URL'. It is the ONLY check of the served response (_headers, edge injections).
not_derivable: The default-branch restriction of check_run/workflow_dispatch is GitHub behaviour not stated in the repo.

evidence.summary: Header comment on deployment_status; push trigger; SITE resolution per branch.
